title: After Desdunes: Buddy Bo, and Harry's own band
summary: Back home Harry played with Buddy Bo, then led his own band with Eddie Palud, Eddie Thomas and Harold, playing weekends while holding a day job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
